citation.source: USDA vegetable subgroup crediting charts (state child-nutrition agency reproductions of the USDA Food Buying Guide's subgroup list) explicitly list onions under the 'Other Vegetables' subgroup; general as-served-volume crediting: 1 cup served credits as 1 cup eq.
citation.note: Confirmed against multiple state-agency reproductions of the FBG subgroup list, not the primary FBG PDF table directly.
